title: Container
summary: A max-width, padded content region, optionally scrolling on its own. Wraps a gallery stage, a code view or a doc-like page instead of a hand-styled div with max-width, padding and overflow.

props.name: size
props.description: Max width, on the content scale (sm --content-sm, md --content-md, lg --content-lg). full removes the max width.

props.name: padding
props.description: Padding on the spacing scale (none 0, xs --space-1, sm --space-2, md --space-4, lg --space-6, xl --space-8).

props.name: align
props.description: center margins the region within its parent (the usual page layout); start pins it to the inline start instead.

props.name: scroll
props.description: Makes the region scroll on its own instead of growing with its content: y for vertical overflow, both for vertical and horizontal. Needs a parent with a definite height (or fill) to have anything to scroll within. A scrolling region gets tabindex=0 and role=region, and needs label.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name for the scrolling region; required when scroll is not none (a warning is logged once when it is missing). Unused otherwise.

props.name: fill
props.description: Fills a flex or grid parent with a definite height (a workspace pane, an app shell body) instead of sizing to content, so scroll has a height to scroll within.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The max-width, padded region; the scroll container when scroll is set.

cssProperties.name: --pk-container-width
cssProperties.description: Overrides the size prop with any length (or none).

cssProperties.name: --pk-container-pad
cssProperties.description: Overrides the padding prop with any length.

a11y: A plain layout box with no role. With scroll set to y or both, the region becomes a keyboard-reachable landmark: tabindex=0, role=region and aria-label from label, so a keyboard or screen reader user can find and scroll it without a pointer.
